EC1: Patients who undergo iliac crest bone graft harvesting as part of their surgery
EC2: Preexisting neurological deficits [OR] or peripheral neuropathy in the distribution of the sciatic nerve
EC4: Contraindication [AND] to regional anesthesia e.g. bleeding diathesis [OR], coagulopathy
EC6: History of use of over 30mg oxycodone [OR] or equivalent per day
EC8: History of significant psychiatric conditions that may affect patient assessment
